title: Hikko's MC Overhaul
description: Play with your friends with modded MC without needing to buy a server. This has 175 mods, that just barley works fine with all the optimizing mods in here and pushing what Essential Mod can work with without it crashing and using Shaders
body: This is a Fabric based mod pack with 175 mods. My main objective was adding as much as I can to MC while using the Essential Mod without MC crashing while playing it, I have mostly tested it not every single detail to the very bottom but I made it work enough so I don't have to pay for a MC server to play with my friends. This also has shaders so you can change it out to any other shaders you want instead of the 3 I've added. So play at your own risk and I don't recommend lower spec PCs, like below the Gforce 30 series (which I have a 3060)
